selected_categories.reasoning: The core structure is an endless survival run with escalating speed, constant obstacle spawning, score accumulation over time, and instant restart after failure.

The player mainly weaves laterally across a road-like playfield to avoid incoming hazards, which strongly resembles lane-based avoidance even though movement is analog rather than strictly locked to lanes.
The presentation centers on a courier car, road perspective, speed increase, and driving-style dodging, creating a light arcade racing feel without lap structure or opponent racing.
The rising rush multiplier and survival-at-higher-speed pressure give the run a speed-oriented challenge profile, though it is more about avoidance than platforming precision.
The player controls a car-like courier vehicle, but the mechanics are highly abstract arcade dodging rather than simulation, so this is only a weak mechanical overlap.

uncertainty_notes: The strongest ambiguity is between Endless runner and Lane runner game because the playfield suggests lanes, but actual steering is smooth horizontal interpolation.
Racing-related categories are secondary because the game has no track progression, laps, or opponent vehicles.
No other category in the universe better captures a short-form dodge-survival courier road game than the selected top two.
